methods.name: L-MAP

methods.name: Latent Macro Action Planner (L-MAP)
methods.description: Leverages temporal abstractions learned with a state-conditioned VQ-V AE to construct a discrete latent space of macro-actions.

methods.name: CompILE
methods.description: Learns latent codes representing variable-length behavior segments, enabling cross-task generalization.

methods.name: RPL
methods.description: Employs a hierarchical policy architecture to simplify long-horizon tasks by decomposing them into sub-policies.

methods.name: OPAL
methods.description: Introduces a continuous space of primitive actions to reduce distributional shift in offline RL, enhancing policy robustness.

methods.name: PRISE

methods.name: MCTS
methods.description: Monte Carlo Tree Search used for macro-level planning, which iteratively selects actions using the UCT policy, applies progressive widening to balance exploration and exploitation, performs parallel expansion of multiple macro actions and their potential outcomes, and backpropagates estimated Q-values.
